notes.title: Methods to Obtain Gold Coins in 'Mortal and Divine Generals'
notes.content: [h3]Yuanbao is the most important trading currency in "The Legend of Mortals and Gods". Whether it is for exchanging items or purchasing equipment, Yuanbao is indispensable. Yuanbao can mainly be obtained through three ways: Yuanbao dungeons, idle income, and achievements. [/h3][p][/p][h3]1. Yuanbao Dungeon (Golden Toad's Treasure Cave) [/h3][p][/p][p]Click the Trial button on the right, then click the Golden Toad Treasure Cave below to access the元宝副本. The元宝副本 is a special dungeon that drops元宝. The higher the level of the dungeon you clear， the more元宝 you will get. At the 30th floor， you can activate the sweeping mode to directly pass through to the highest level you have reached before. [/p][h3][/h3][h3]2. Rewards from Leveling Up and Idle Gaming [/h3][p][/p][p]Click the "Level Up" button on the left, then click the "Treasure Chest" button on the left to open the earnings interface. You can claim the idle earnings at regular intervals. The longer the interval, the richer the earnings. The earnings can be stored for up to one day (24 hours). [/p][p][/p][p]Each immortal friend has one free sweep opportunity every day, which can earn 4 hours of placement income. There are also two jade sweep opportunities, both of which can earn 4 hours of placement income. [/p][p][/p][h3]3. Achievements [/h3][p][/p][p]Click the "Daily" button on the right, then click the "Achievements" button at the bottom to enter the achievements interface. Complete the corresponding achievements as per the requirements of the achievement tasks to obtain a large amount of gold coins and enhance your combat power by advancing your Dao stage.[/p]

notes.title: Tips for Obtaining Immortal Jade in "Mortal and Divine Generals"
notes.content: [h3]In "The Legend of Mortals and Gods", the most important and scarce currency item is the Immortal Jade. While gold coins may be abundant in the game, Immortal Jade is not so plentiful. It has more uses than gold coins and is also more difficult to obtain. [/h3][p][/p][h3]1.Recharge [/h3][p][/p][p]Recharging is naturally the fastest and most direct way to obtain Xianyu in the game. Xianyou should act according to your own actual situation and do it within your means. Of course, recharging is not omnipotent at all times. It also depends on how Xianyou rationally utilize Xianyu to make your cultivation journey more efficient. [/p][p][/p][h3]2. Treasure Basin [/h3][p][/p][p]If you have extra or temporarily unused Xianyu, you can deposit it into the Treasure Basin. Each time, you can only deposit or withdraw 5,000 Xianyu. The more Xianyu you deposit, the more interest you can earn. You can claim the interest every 4 hours. Please note that the Xianyu interest can be accumulated for a maximum of 24 hours. [/p][p][/p][h3]3. Privileges [/h3][p][/p][p]Privilege cards are divided into three types: Purple Diamond, Red Diamond, and Gold Diamond. Each of these privilege cards allows you to claim Xianyu every day, along with a series of privileges. Although they may not seem like a lot, over time, you can accumulate a considerable amount of Xianyu. Whether you need them or not, dear players, you can make a judgment based on your actual gameplay experience. [/p][p][/p][h3]4. On the Tao [/h3][p][/p][p]In the Immortal Interface, friends can enter the "Lecture on Tao" by clicking the "Trial" button on the right side. Here, they can engage in cross-server battles with other players to compete in power. The more consecutive victories you achieve, the more Immortal Jade you will obtain. The higher the rank you advance to, the more Immortal Jade you will get. Completing multiple "Lecture on Tao" competitions will also grant you rich rewards and a large amount of Immortal Jade. [/p][p][/p][h3]5. The Long March of the Sect [/h3][p][/p][p]This method requires that fellow immortals join the sect to participate. After joining the sect's expedition, whether winning or losing, one can receive immortal jade rewards and sacrificial immortal crystals (used for sect lottery), and the winners will receive even more and richer rewards.[/p]
